text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement all-way stop control at the intersection of Leonard Avenue and Wales Avenue. This will clearly establish right-of-way and enhance pedestrian, cyclist, and vehicular safety at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Leonard Avenue and Wales Avenue.
